_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cable signals

pit_profile.why: 'Competition for the cable services we offer consists primarily of DBS operators and local phone companies' (FY2008 10-K); 'Intensifying competition and a weakening economy affected our net customer additions in 2008'; 'We expect advances in communications technology, such as video streaming over the Internet, to continue in the future, and we are unable to predict what effects these developments will have on our businesses and operations'; competitors include 'online services that offer Internet video streaming, downloading and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'

classification.quality_note: 'Competition for the cable services we offer consists primarily of DBS operators and local phone companies' (FY2008 10-K); 'Intensifying competition and a weakening economy affected our net customer additions in 2008'; 'We expect advances in communications technology, such as video streaming over the Internet, to continue in the future, and we are unable to predict what effects these developments will have on our businesses and operations'; competitors include 'online services that offer Internet video streaming, downloading and distribution of movies, television shows and other video programming'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.03x; -45% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.10; conservative 2yr +204%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.7%/yr (worst year FY04-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.1%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 6.1-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +35.1%/yr (FY04-FY09 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +72.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY09); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CMCSA (retrospective, 2010-02-19) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.03x (25.0% downside to Bear $12 / +893.8% upside to Bull $159) | Adj composite 2.10 vs market 1.00: gap +1.10 [UNDERVALUED] | -45% above the EPP floor $29 (23x FY10E $1.26) | Conservative 2-yr case: +203.5% total (+101.8%/yr) | At 12.7x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $21 sits at or below the BASE case; video subscribers -2.6% in Q4 2009, forward revenues +2.9% (no FY10 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2009 revenue growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
